meta.name: alterlab-proteinmpnn
meta.description: Design protein sequences for a fixed backbone with ProteinMPNN (Dauparas 2022) — message-passing inverse folding that outputs sequences predicted to fold to a given structure, with fixed positions, tied/symmetric chains, amino-acid bias, and a soluble-model variant. Use when inverse-folding a backbone PDB into sequences, redesigning selected positions, imposing symmetry across chains, or generating the sequence step of a design→fold→score loop. For pocket/interface design WITH a bound ligand, metal, or nucleic acid prefer alterlab-ligandmpnn; to GENERATE a new backbone prefer alterlab-rfdiffusion; to refold and validate a design prefer alterlab-alphafold; for generative multimodal design prefer alterlab-esm. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 根据蛋白质骨架设计对应序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做蛋白质逆折叠或结构设计。
copy.tagline_en: Design protein sequences for a given backbone structure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing protein inverse folding or structure-based design.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以根据你提供的蛋白质骨架结构（PDB 文件），设计出能折叠成该结构的氨基酸序列。它还能固定某些位置、强制对称链、调整氨基酸偏好，并支持可溶性模型。
howto.when: 当你需要为已有的蛋白质骨架设计序列，或重新设计部分位置、强制链间对称时触发。也适用于设计→折叠→评分循环中的序列生成步骤。

say.text: 请为这个 PDB 骨架设计 8 条候选序列，采样温度 0.1。
固定第 10、20 位为丙氨酸，重新设计其余位置。
say.note: Claude 会解析固定位置规格并执行部分设计。

say.text: 对两条链施加对称约束，使它们获得相同序列。
say.note: Claude 会设置 tied positions 参数。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can design amino-acid sequences predicted to fold to a given protein backbone (PDB). It supports fixed positions, tied/symmetric chains, amino-acid bias, and a soluble model variant.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to inverse-fold a backbone PDB into sequences, redesign selected positions, enforce chain symmetry, or generate the sequence step of a design→fold→score loop.

say_en.text: Design 8 candidate sequences for this backbone PDB with sampling temperature 0.1.
say_en.note: Claude runs ProteinMPNN and returns a FASTA.

say_en.text: Fix positions 10 and 20 to alanine, redesign the rest.
say_en.note: Claude parses fixed-position spec and runs partial design.

say_en.text: Enforce symmetry across two chains so they get identical sequences.
